group_metric_scope: Equal-group MSE is an additional descriptive weighting; primary MSE remains per row. It does not replace or tune the frozen selection.

prior_accounting.next_research_priority: Evaluate whether actual experiments implement their stated comparison and whether development-set improvements survive appropriate confirmation. Preserve valid joint exploration; do not infer single-factor attribution from joint changes. Avoid additional default memory engineering without measured research benefit.
prior_accounting.scope: All eighteen frozen reference-comparison projects complete, original failures retained, existing returned plans consumed once, one unused original decision completed, numeric confirmation repaired. Both main heads pushed and clean. No live experimental processes.

scope: Post-selection sensitivity analysis of frozen prior gains. Eight new group splits per source dataset, plus independently permuted counterparts. Selected methods and ablations are fixed before all new fits. Reused data and overlapping splits do not establish independent replication, significance or general research superiority.
time_scope: Concurrent project times overlap. Native project time includes initialization, capture and paired fits. Preparation-through-execution includes gaps after freeze but excludes prior driver design and subsequent reporting. CPU fit wall seconds are not OS CPU usage or monetized cost.
